metadata.query: select pl_name,hostname,ra,dec,sy_dist,pl_orbsmax,pl_orbper,pl_rade,pl_bmasse,pl_bmassprov,pl_eqt,disc_year,discoverymethod from pscomppars order by pl_name
metadata.scope: All confirmed exoplanets in pscomppars; no candidate or distance filters.
